name: Google Docs
description: Read and edit Google Docs documents
author: flock

requires.rationale: A saved Google browser session is the reliable path for Docs — no per-scope OAuth app review, and one session covers all Google skills.

auth.setup_instructions: Log in to your Google account via the browser session manager to access Docs.

appendText.reason: Types into the Docs editor in the browser, then reads the document back to confirm the edit: 15-45s per call. A shorter limit kills a write that may still land, and the account stays busy for the next call.
